simulation.official_subtitle: Since 10/06/2026 · current rules (Policy C + smoothed score + risk filters + VIX regime)
simulation.full_subtitle: Includes PRE_ENSEMBLE cycles before the reliable ensemble · do not use to evaluate the current strategy
simulation.full_card_warning: Includes PRE_ENSEMBLE — result not comparable with the current strategy
simulation.scope_note: The official track record only uses the period in which the 60% score v3 + 40% XGBoost ensemble and all risk rules are active and auditable. The full history includes earlier, incomplete cycles and is for reference only.
simulation.pre_ensemble_tooltip: PRE_ENSEMBLE = cycles before 10/06/2026, before the 60% score v3 + 40% XGBoost ensemble was reliable and auditable. Those cycles were missing fields (score_v3 / xgb_proba) or the current rules were not yet all active. This history should therefore not be used to evaluate the official strategy.
simulation.sharpe_note: Sharpe and Sortino computed on returns in excess of the annual risk-free rate of {{rf}}%.
simulation.score_note: Final score = 60% score v3 + 40% XGBoost probability. Sizing: volatility target, fractional Kelly and a 25% cap per category (sum of the category's ETFs; excess redistributed, or cash if all categories are at the cap).
simulation.ensemble_status: Reliable ensemble active since {{since}} · status: {{status}} · legacy cycles excluded: {{legacy}}
simulation.regime_rules_default: BULL regime requires VWCE > SMA200 and VIX < {{stress}}; BEAR/STRESS stay in cash.
simulation.regime_rules_legacy: Binary filter: BULL (VWCE > SMA200 and VIX < {{stress}}) invested; otherwise cash.
simulation.regime_rules_vix: Regime filter: BULL (VWCE > SMA200, VIX < {{neutral}}) 100% · NEUTRAL (VIX {{neutral}}–{{stress}}) max. 60% · STRESS (VIX ≥ {{stress}}) and BEAR (VWCE < SMA200) 100% cash. Without VIX only the SMA200 is used; a regime change forces a rebalance.
simulation.policy_line_smoothed: Policy {{policy}} · threshold ≥ {{threshold}}% · minimum holding {{holding}} cycles · max. {{max_new}} new positions/cycle · rebalance every {{interval}} cycle(s) · ranking: smoothed score_final (mean t, t-1) · cycles without rotation: {{no_rotation}}
simulation.policy_line_raw: Policy {{policy}} · threshold ≥ {{threshold}}% · minimum holding {{holding}} cycles · max. {{max_new}} new positions/cycle · rebalance every {{interval}} cycle(s) · ranking: raw score_final, no smoothing · cycles without rotation: {{no_rotation}}
simulation.cons_no_category_limit: no limit on ETFs per category
simulation.cons_vol_exclude: no new entries with vol_21 in the universe's top quartile
simulation.cons_vol_halve: 50% weight for vol_21 in the universe's top quartile
simulation.cons_early_vol: {{pct}}% vol target in the first cycles
simulation.maxdd_note: Max drawdown measured on the daily equity curve from the €10,000 starting capital (includes the 1st cycle). Using only end-of-cycle values it would be {{v}}%.
simulation.stress_note: Worst rolling 21-session windows for VWCE; strategy return estimated from conditional alpha/beta.
simulation.regime_eval_note: Evaluated on the construction date of each simulated portfolio cycle.
simulation.vix_fallback: ⚠ VIX unavailable or stale — the regime is using the SMA200 only (fallback).
